summary: The truthy test takes an input expression and convert_bool to interpret yes/no, on/off, 0/1 as booleans.
questions: How do I make truthy understand yes/no strings?

answer_card.title: truthy test parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required)
- `convert_bool` (false): interpret `yes`/`no`, `on`/`off`, `0`/`1` strictly, e.g. `'no' is truthy(convert_bool=true)` → False
